headline: Zillow's lead model
goes *all Preferred*
slides.sub: Two-thirds of buyer connections already run through the pay-at-closing program, formerly Flex.
slides.fig_caption: Share of connections Zillow expects Preferred to handle in the first half of 2027

slides.label: of Q3 buyer connections went to a *Preferred partner*
slides.body: That is up from about one-third a year earlier. Zillow expects more than 75% by year-end.

slides.title: From ads to *pay at closing*
points: Partners pay a referral fee when a deal closes, not upfront advertising fees as under Premier Agent.
Zillow says Preferred connections close at a higher rate and earn Zillow *35% more revenue* per connection than its legacy model.
Zillow says it will keep adding agents as connection volume and agent capacity grow.

slides.label: of the category's monthly unique visitors went to Zillow, a *record*
slides.body: That is Comscore's read. Zillow's own count slipped, with monthly users down 3% to 215 million and visits down 5% to 2.3 billion.

slides.title: Know where *you stand*
slides.body: Zillow's CEO did not spell out what happens to Premier Agent advertisers who don't qualify. If Zillow feeds your pipeline, ask your rep now, and keep building leads you own.
